valor: Comedia agridulce sobre un canciller que se prepara para dejar el cargo tras años de servicio a su país. Con apenas dos días para disfrutar de su lujosa villa antes de ser desalojado, su situación va de mal en peor.
motivo: La publicada es comentario sobre la película, no sinopsis; traducida del overview de TMDB.

antes.aleste-2026: La única película dirigida por Václav Havel, basada en su última obra literaria, es una reflexión autobiográfica y una libre interpretación de «El rey Lear», de Shakespeare y «El jardín de los cerezos», de Chéjov.

valor: A bittersweet comedy about a chancellor set to step down from his position after years of service to his country. With just two days left to enjoy his palatial villa before he is evicted, his situation gradually goes from bad to worse.
motivo: Erratas: "who set to step down", "two last days left", "highly appointed".

antes.aleste-2026: A bitter sweet comedy that follows a highly appointed Chancellor who set to step down from his position after years of service to his country. With just two last days left to enjoy his palatial villa before he is finally evicted, his situation gradually goes from bad to worse.
